methodology: Sequential browser medians use only canonical valid repetitions 1–5; aborted, intermediate and instrumented collections are excluded.
Observed Navigation/Paint/PerformanceObserver/CDP values are separate from Lighthouse simulated timing audits.
The observed long-task blocking sum is not Lighthouse TBT. Scripted Event Timing is not field INP.
Matching shell interactions use only the five named actions and interactionId > 0. Missing thresholded samples are not zero.
Desktop-ready timestamps include the scripted observation and guest-entry sequence; start-screen-ready describes initial readiness.
Warm contexts preserve primed cache and state. DNS/TLS/OS caches were not forcibly cleared.
Coverage and drag are individual instrumented diagnostics and do not contribute to primary medians.
